# Aegis-404 Conventions

## Code style
- Python: PEP8, type hints required, docstrings on all functions
- Shell scripts: bash, set -euo pipefail at top of every script
- All files: UTF-8, Unix line endings (LF)

## File headers
Every agent-generated file must start with:

  # Generated by Aegis-404
  # Date: <ISO 8601 date>
  # Task: <one-line description of what this file does>

## Security conventions
- No hardcoded secrets ever — use environment variable references
- Flag any code that does network I/O with a # NETWORK comment
- Flag any code that writes to disk with a # DISK-WRITE comment
- If generating a shell script that uses sudo or su, refuse and explain why

## Commit message format
  <type>(<scope>): <short description>

  Types: feat, fix, docs, chore, security, refactor, test
  Example: security(scanner): add SAST rule for SQL injection patterns

## Report format
Security reports go in /workspace/reports/ as Markdown files:
  YYYY-MM-DD-<report-name>.md

Structure:
  # Report Title
  ## Summary
  ## Findings
  ## Recommendations
  ## References
